notes: Consumers must pin to this tag, not master. Fetch with: npm run fetch-cards. Supported corpus is System Gateway → System Update 2021 only (stubs/wave1/wave2 removed in v0.2.0). If the GitHub tag is unavailable, set CARDS_DATA_ROOT to a local checkout of netrunner-cards-data (or place it as a sibling ../netrunner-cards-data).
